title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 25 (Stone Mountain)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Stone Mountain
25 That portion of M.U.s 7-50, 7-51 and 7-54 contained within the described boundaries of Stone Mountain Provincial Park, within a distance of one mile (1.6 kilometres) of the Alaska Highway. [en. B.C. Reg. 476/2004, s. (a).]
